entities.summary: Corey Andrew Wootton is an American former professional football player who was a defensive end in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Northwestern Wildcats. As a junior, he garnered first-team All-Big Ten Conference honors. He was selected by the Chicago Bears in the fourth round of the 2010 NFL draft. He has also played for the Minnesota Vikings and Detroit Lions.
